q: Who founded Thammasat University?
ctx:
Thammasat University (TU)
TU was founded by Pridi Banomyong on June 27, 1934. The university is well-known for law, political science, and economics. TU has two main campuses: Tha Prachan campus in Bangkok, which is the original campus, and Rangsit campus in Pathum Thani, which is much larger. Most first-year students study at the Rangsit campus.

q: When was LINE MAN launched?
ctx:
LINE MAN Food Delivery Service
LINE MAN is Thailand’s leading food delivery platform, launched in 2016. The service has grown rapidly and now operates in more than 30 provinces. Food delivery remains the most popular service, accounting for 70% of all orders. The platform partners with over 100,000 restaurants. Delivery fees typically range from 15-49 Baht. LINE MAN employs more than 80,000 delivery riders.
